description: tokens_in and tokens_out are 0 on satisfier and walk execution rows, so the cost of reaching a goal cannot be computed from traces, and no claim about the system becoming MORE ECONOMICALLY EFFICIENT over time can be verified or falsified. Verified 2026-09-20 on fresh rows (e.g. execution exec_5y1hp1de and the universal-tool-fallback rows carry tokens_in: 0, tokens_out: 0 while their tasks demonstrably ran LLM calls); the 2026-09-18 crystallization measurement already hit this and had to meter by counting journal lines instead, which does not survive log rotation and is invisible to any in-substrate consumer. cost_usd is likewise 0f. Without a cost denominator, reuse-vs-rederive decisions, arm cost posteriors (the boredom cost model V30 reads predicted-vs-validated cost), and any acceleration measurement are all starved of their input.
